question: The three-year Public–Private Partnership (PPP) project pipeline launched by the Government of India in January 2026 covers projects worth approximately how much value?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹17 lakh crore.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **India launched a three-year PPP project pipeline covering 852 projects worth over ₹17 lakh crore to boost infrastructure development.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The PPP pipeline includes 852 infrastructure projects with an estimated value exceeding ₹17 lakh crore.**
 
• Projects span Central ministries, States and Union Territories across multiple sectors.
 
• The pipeline is anchored in the Ministry of Finance to ensure coordination and credibility.
 
• PPP Project Pipeline__ 
 __
 
• Provides early visibility to investors, lenders and developers
 
• Reduces uncertainty and improves project bankability
 
• Aims to attract domestic and foreign private investment
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Public–Private Partnership (PPP)__

 __
 
• Infrastructure delivery model involving government and private sector
 
• Leverages private capital, technology and operational efficiency
 
• Risks are shared between public and private partners
 
 
 
• Sectors Covered__
 __
 
• Transport and logistics
 
• Energy and urban infrastructure
 
• Water, social and public service sectors
 
 
 
• Expected Impact__
 
 
• Faster project execution and reduced delays
 
• Lower infrastructure costs
 
• Support to economic growth and employment generation
